name: tab_items_listing
title: Tab Items Listing
summary: Items of a type with badge labels beside their content.
description: Renders items of a given type with badge labels aside the item content sections. Jobs: data.experience.attributes (with data.experience.heading above) is shown as an icon_list (.tab-items-listing-list) with flex, one full-width item per row; data.experience.working_for ({"label": "Working for", "items": ["<job _id>", ...]}) shows the client jobs as small links (logo 28px high + name) to their card on the same page (#<seo.slug>), or plain text when the client job has render: false.
